title: 第19章 那个大魔就是我第20章 脸红个泡泡茶壶啊
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
而这个家伙，居然敢让他喝这种东西！
二话不说，林恩瞬间就撸起了并不存在的袖子，鼻子（▼ヘ▼#）地喷出了一股蒸气，就想要上去和他发难。
花耶立刻哇呀呀呀地（〃＞皿＜）地挡在林恩的面前。
“等一下！等一下啊！！”
都自己人，不要起冲突！不可以起冲突的啊！！
琼斯一怔，立刻就明白了过来，顿时有些汗颜。道：
“不好意思！抱歉了，毕竟你刚才突然说那种话，我还以为你和那个大魔真的有什么关系……误会！毕竟这也是我们的职责所在，要不你看这样吧……”
说着。
他笑着从怀中摸出了一把秘银的燧发手枪，哗啦啦打了个枪花之后，将枪柄递了过去。
同时递上的还有一张小小的卡片。
“能在红月之下还在外面行走的人，你应该也是一个很厉害的职业者吧，送你了，留着防身。”
“当然，如果你有想法加入我们驱魔队的话，等这次事件结束之后，随时可以来找我，我相信一个身心纯洁的人，一定能够成为一名高尚的驱魔人！”
花耶一愣。
然后立刻就瞪大了眼睛。
“这是……”
而林恩的眼前也是浮现出了那把枪的面板。
【秘银燧发枪（改装）】
【品质】：精致
【特性】：可自动为子弹附加【圣焰】的效果，此附魔为永久状态。
【射程】：200米

【介绍】：驱魔协会所配备的制式火器，与秘银弩一起构成了驱魔队的装备体系，对恶灵即怪诞拥有一定的克制作用。
而和这把枪一起递过来的那个金色的小卡片，则更是一下引起了花耶的注意。
【驱魔凭证】：由驱魔协会所颁发的信任凭证。
“诶？！”
花耶顿时（ΩДΩ）了。
“这……这……这是资格凭证？！开什么玩笑，你才见了人家一面就发这种东西？！而且这不是需要去你们那里考试才能拿到的资格证吗？！”
她当然见过这种东西，因为她的姐姐手里就有一张。
而这也是可以成为正式驱魔人的资格。
用人话来说。
这是编制的证明，是需要经过层层的选拔和考试，才有资格获得的加入驱魔队的凭证。
琼斯嘴角微翘，道：
“正常情况下是这样，但我是队长，所以我有保举的资格，而更重要的是……我看人的眼光，从不出错。”
“要不然你姐姐又怎么可能会加入我的驱魔队呢？”
毕竟，挖掘新人也是队长所需要具备的优良品质。
而更重要的是。
content_en:
And this guy actually dared to let him drink this kind of thing!
Without saying a word, Lin En rolled up his non-existent sleeves in an instant, blew out a stream of steam from his nose, and wanted to go up and fight him.
Hua Ye immediately stood in front of Lin En and stood in front of Lin En.
"Wait a minute! Wait a minute!!"
We are all on our own, no conflicts! There can be no conflict! !
Jones was startled and immediately understood, feeling a little ashamed. Said:
"I'm sorry! I'm sorry. After all, you suddenly said that just now. I thought you really had something to do with that big devil... I misunderstood! After all, this is also our responsibility. How about you see it this way..."
Said.
He smiled and took out a mithril flintlock pistol from his arms. After a quick shot, he handed over the handle of the gun.
Also handed over was a small card.
"If you can still walk outside under the red moon, you must be a very powerful professional. I'll give it to you and keep it for self-defense."
"Of course, if you have the idea of joining our exorcism team, you can come to me at any time after this incident is over. I believe that a person with pure mind and body will be able to become a noble exorcist!"
Huaye was stunned.
Then his eyes widened immediately.
"This is..."
And the faceplate of the gun also appeared in front of Lin En's eyes.
[Mithril flintlock (modified)]
[Quality]: Exquisite
[Characteristics]: Can automatically add [Holy Flame] effect to bullets. This enchantment is permanent.
[Range]: 200 meters
[Introduction]: The standard firearms equipped by the Exorcist Association, together with the mithril crossbow, form the equipment system of the exorcist team, which has a certain restraint effect on evil spirits and grotesques.
The small golden card handed over with the gun immediately caught Huaye's attention.
[Exorcism Certificate]: A certificate of trust issued by the Exorcist Association.
"Eh?!"
The flowers bloomed suddenly (ΩДΩ).
"This... this... this is a qualification certificate?! Are you kidding me, you just give out something like this when you meet someone?! And isn't this a qualification certificate that I need to take an exam at your place to get it?!"
Of course she had seen something like this before, because her sister had one.
And this is also the qualification to become an official exorcist.
In human terms.
This is proof of establishment, and it is a certificate that requires you to go through layers of selection and examination before you are qualified to join the exorcism team.
Jones raised the corners of his mouth slightly and said:
"That's the case under normal circumstances, but I'm the captain, so I'm qualified to be recommended, and more importantly... I never make mistakes when it comes to looking at people."
"Otherwise, how could your sister join my exorcism team?"
After all, discovering new talents is also a good quality that a captain needs to possess.
And more importantly.
